subject: Onboarding checklist: PO rotation & legacy line merge
messages:
From: Alex Torres <atorres@solstice-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-admin@solstice-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO issuance / legacy SKU map

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. We're kicking off onboarding for Solstice's internal analytics team and need to align on two items before procurement can issue the first PO:

1) PO rotation and numbering: we have a legacy contract manager who prefers to keep older POs for reconciliation. Can Redwood issue a new PO series scoped to this engagement (distinct prefix) and also include a migration map to tie legacy line items to the new PO lines?

2) Spend cap validation: our finance team requires a per-line spend cap and an aggregated monthly cap by cost center. Can you confirm how Redwood expects spend caps to be represented on the PO (single total vs per-line limit)?

Attached is our completed onboarding form and a proposed PO matrix for how we'd like lines broken out. Can you review and confirm what you'll accept so procurement can create the official PO?

Appreciate it — if easier, hop on a 15-min call tomorrow.

Best,
Alex Torres
Head of Procurement
Solstice Analytics
attachments: solstice_onboard_form.pdf, proposed_po_matrix.csv

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@solstice-analytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO issuance / legacy SKU map

Alex — thanks for the detailed packet. Looping in Finance/Onboarding (Grace) and Vendor Ops (Marcus) to confirm internal constraints. Quick answers up front:

- We can create a dedicated PO prefix for Solstice (example: RDW-SOL-2026-###). That will keep ledger separation clean.
- We support both aggregate caps and per-line spend caps. For billing controls we prefer per-line caps with an overall monthly cap attached in the PO header — that makes automated enforcement easier in our billing pipeline.

Requests / next steps for you:
- If you want legacy POs reconciled, please provide a CSV that maps legacy_po_num -> legacy_line_code -> desired_new_line_code (we can accept the format in legacy_line_map.xlsx).
- Confirm which cost centers map to the monthly cap and the contact for invoice exceptions.

I've attached a short onboarding checklist that shows required fields on the PO to ensure automated acceptance. Grace — can you validate the proposed line splits in Solstice's CSV and confirm the spend-cap enforcement approach? Marcus — will you confirm the PO prefix and whether any manual routing is needed for the first 2 POs?

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Alex Torres <atorres@solstice-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO issuance / legacy SKU map

Jordan / Alex — I reviewed the proposed_po_matrix.csv and made a few normalization edits: see inline notes below (excerpt). I'm attaching legacy_line_map.xlsx with suggested merged keys.

-- Grace (internal notes copied into email for clarity):
* Line A1 (compute-hours) — split into two lines: A1.1 (dedicated-dedicated) and A1.2 (burst). This prevents overrun risk when autoscaling spikes.
* Line B3 (support) — consolidate B3 and B3-legacy into a single line B3-STD to simplify invoicing; include a per-line cap of $12,500/month.
* Aggregated monthly cap: Solstice requested $85,000/month for Q4 pilot. We recommend setting the PO header cap to $90,000 to leave a 5% buffer for metering variance; finance requires written approval for any tolerance above header cap.

Please confirm these revisions so I can sign off and route to Procurement for issuance. Marcus — when you create the PO prefix please set initial internal approvals so the first two POs route to Procurement and the Billing SME for handoff (one-time manual step).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Finance Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: legacy_line_map.xlsx
